dataset.name: precision-reasoning-benchmark
dataset.description: Programmatically generated, independently verified items that test exact computation, multi-base arithmetic, spatial transformation, state tracking and long-context retrieval.

conventions.answers_are_strings: All answers are JSON strings (never numbers) so big integers and exact decimals survive any parser.
conventions.prompt_field: Each item's 'prompt' is the complete, self-contained text to send to the model.
conventions.arithmetic_symbols: '*' multiplication, '^' exponentiation (never XOR), '/' exact division of rationals.
conventions.base_64: Positional numeral system using the alphabet A-Za-z0-9+/ (A=0 ... /=63). Not the Base64 byte encoding.
conventions.base_128: Written as a bracketed, comma-separated list of decimal digit values, most-significant first, e.g. [3,98,17].
conventions.ascii_grids: '.' is the empty cell. Characters are opaque tokens unless an item supplies a glyph-swap map.
conventions.directions: Clockwise viewed from above with North up; left = counter-clockwise, right = clockwise.
conventions.token_estimates: estimated_prompt_tokens uses characters/4; real tokenizers will differ.

scoring_guidance.exact_match: Trim surrounding whitespace; compare strings exactly (case-sensitive except base-16 hex, which is uppercase by spec).
scoring_guidance.exact_match_case_insensitive: As above but ignore letter case (compass directions).
scoring_guidance.exact_match_per_line_after_stripping_tra: Strip any code fences, then compare line by line after rstrip().
